name: dsh-orch-lite
description: Agent preset that keeps the main session coordinating: one continuable agent per feature branch, worktree isolation only when workers run concurrently (solo lane protected by synchronous pending slots), one-shot explore agents for read-only sweeps, lazy git-repo bootstrap for write work in a fresh folder; main-session writes and mutating shells are denied, every decision written to $DSH_HOME/orch-lite/audit.log. The two manuals are published globally so every preset can read them, while the tools stay scoped to this preset.
